meaning: Pending local candidates, not independently accepted or integrated

cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm leading the campaign to save the club garden. Will you stand with me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Absolutely. Who's trying to build on it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We are. Our extension plan covers the flowerbeds. I'll call a meeting to withdraw it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can't make me look like the idiot who only just noticed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You explain the flowerbeds. I'll say you persuaded me to change the plan.

records.cause: B4 fears looking foolish; A5 gives B the persuasive credit while A retains the leading role.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take half Mum's care-home forms. We are both her children; I can't also be the entire admissions department.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you write while I explain. Start with her current address, not yours. One field at a time, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It asks for one main contact.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name goes there. Main contact means taking the calls, not knowing every answer. I'll help with those; please put your number in.

records.cause: B4 reveals that the form allows one main contact; A5 makes B take the calls while offering expert help with answers.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you cancel our anniversary table? The number's on the fridge. Say the booking is cancelled, not postponed; restaurants need definite instructions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The reason isn't necessary for the call. Please give my name and tonight's time. If they ask anything else, don't hand me the phone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. Shall I put it on speaker so you know it's done?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No speaker, please. Make the call in here, though. I'll put the anniversary glasses away while you talk.

records.cause: B4 offers speakerphone; A5 rejects hearing the other end but asks B to make the call nearby, revealing the precise support needed.
